integrationsClientFileNotTaken: {name} takes no client file in this version of Infinitary.
integrationsConnectOfferBody: Your first mate and your crew can then reach {name} with your sign-in. Each of its actions, reads included, asks you on a card until you choose Always allow.
integrationsConnectOfferOpen: Open Integrations to sign in to {name}.
integrationsGoogleClientFileIncomplete: That client file has no client ID or secret. Download it again from Google's page.
integrationsGoogleClientFileNotJson: That isn't a Google client file. On Google's page, download your client's file with Download JSON, then drop it here.
integrationsGoogleClientFileWeb: That file is for a web application client. Make a Desktop app client on Google's page, then drop its file here.
integrationsGoogleExchangeOperation: Finish the Google sign-in with your own Google client
integrationsGoogleExchangeReason: Infinitary finishes your Google sign-in with your own Google client.
integrationsGoogleExchangeResult: A new Google sign-in, kept in Secrets and the app's memory
integrationsGoogleReadyDetail: Your own Google client is kept. Sign in with it to move off Infinitary's shared client.
integrationsGoogleRetiringDetail: Google is connected through Infinitary's shared client, which is retiring. It keeps working until then; set up your own client to stay connected.
integrationsGoogleSetUpFirst: Set up your own Google client first, in Settings → Integrations → Google.
integrationsGoogleSetupLead: Infinitary reaches Gmail and Calendar through a client you make in your own Google Cloud project, in Google's Personal mode. Google doesn't review it, shows no warning, and doesn't end its sign-in after 7 days.
integrationsGoogleSetupStays: Infinitary keeps the client's secret in Secrets on this computer. Your first mate and your crew never see it.
integrationsGoogleSetupStepFile: Download the client file Google shows with Download JSON, then drop it here, choose it, or paste what it holds.
integrationsGoogleSetupStepPage: Open Google's page and sign in with the Google account you'll connect. Name the project, accept Google's policy and press Continue.
integrationsGoogleSetupTitle: Set up your own Google connection
integrationsGoogleSignInHint: Sign in with the Google account that made your client: it serves only that account.
integrationsGoogleStoppedDetail: Google no longer accepts your client, perhaps because it was deleted in Google Cloud. Set it up again to reconnect Google.
integrationsGoogleStopsDetail: This client isn't in Personal mode, so Google ends its sign-in {date}. Set up a client in Personal mode to keep Google connected.
integrationsMcpOfferBody: {name} asks for a sign-in, which you make in your browser. Its tools then ask you on a card until you choose Always allow.
integrationsMcpOfferOpen: Open Integrations: the MCP server form is filled in, and connecting opens the sign-in page.
integrationsMcpRenewOperation: Renew the {name} sign-in so its tools keep working
integrationsMcpRenewReason: Infinitary renews your {name} sign-in so its tools keep working.
integrationsMcpRenewResult: A new {name} access key, kept only in the app's memory
integrationsMcpRevokeOperation: Tell {name} to forget the sign-in you removed
integrationsMcpRevokeReason: Infinitary tells {name} to forget the sign-in you removed.
integrationsMcpRevokeResult: Nothing kept: the sign-in ends there
integrationsSignInNoneAgain: {name} has no sign-in to make again.
integrationsSignInPageNotSignedIn: Not signed in to {name}. You can close this tab and go back to Infinitary.
integrationsSignInPageSignedIn: Signed in to {name}. You can close this tab and go back to Infinitary.
integrationsSignInWaiting: Finish signing in to {name} in your browser.
